title: Appealing

replies.author: Midnightstorm
replies.body:
Hello ElementAlassassin,

I apologize sincerely for the inconvenience. I am now aware that you did not mean to advertise, making your ban false. I joined the game moments before seeing you post the ip and was not aware of the situation. Once again, I would like to apologize for my mistake. A Senior Moderator will lock your appeal shortly, I hope to see you soon.

Thank you for your patience and for submitting an appeal.

Regards,
Midnightstorm
